moyo-tented-camp: A tented camp in the northern Serengeti, positioned for the Mara River area and the migration in the dry months. A good base for travellers who want to be close to the river crossings, with a quieter feel than the central plains. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
ang-ata-migration-camp: A seasonal tented camp at Ndutu in the southern Serengeti ecosystem, used when the herds are on the short-grass plains for calving, roughly December to March. Best for travellers who want predators and newborn animals. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
safari-haven-migration-camp: A tented camp in the northern Serengeti used for the river-crossing season. It puts you close to the Mara area, where herds and predators gather in the middle and later part of the year. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
nakupenda-luxury-camp: A tented camp in the central Serengeti, near Seronera, which has year-round game viewing and good cat sightings. A convenient base for a first visit and for reaching the plains and kopjes. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
farm-of-dreams-lodge: A lodge at Karatu, on the highland road between Lake Manyara and Ngorongoro. It is a comfortable, cooler stop, often used the night before or after the crater, and surrounded by farmland and coffee country. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
fig-tree-lodge: A lodge at Mto wa Mbu, the lively village at the entrance to Lake Manyara National Park. It is handy for Lake Manyara and for cultural visits, with an easy drive to Ngorongoro and Tarangire. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
mawe-mawe-manyara-lodge: A lodge near Lake Manyara National Park, on the edge of the Rift Valley. It is a good base for the park, birdlife and views over the lake and escarpment. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
ngorongoro-serena-safari-lodge: A lodge on the western rim of the Ngorongoro Crater, with views across the caldera. The position makes for an easy early descent onto the crater floor, and a cool climate, so a warm layer is useful. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
kubu-kubu-tented-lodge: A tented lodge near Tarangire National Park, overlooking the Tarangire River valley. It suits a first or last night on the Northern Circuit, with elephants and baobabs close by. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
masek-tented-lodge: A tented lodge in the Ngorongoro highlands, a cool, scenic area on the road between the crater and the Serengeti. It works as an overnight stop for the crater and the plains. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
lake-eyasi-safari-lodge: A lodge on the shores of Lake Eyasi, used as a base for cultural visits with the Hadzabe and Datoga communities. The area is hot and dry, so mornings are the best time for activities. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
lake-natron-tented-camp: A tented camp at Lake Natron, in the north of the Rift Valley. It is a base for the flamingo lake, waterfall walks and the Oldoinyo Lengai climb. The area is remote and hot, so facilities are simple. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
kibo-palace-hotel: A hotel in Arusha, handy for the night before or after a safari or Kilimanjaro climb. A comfortable base for transfers, gear checks and meeting your guide. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
gold-crest-hotel: A hotel in Arusha suited to arrival and departure nights around a safari or climb. It is in the city, with easy transfers to the airport and the safari gateway. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
tulia-boutique-hotel-and-spa: A boutique hotel and spa in Arusha, good for a relaxed night before or after a safari or climb, with a quieter feel than a large city hotel. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
njiro-legacy-hotel: A hotel in the Njiro area of Arusha, convenient for the airport road and for the first or last night of a trip. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
karibu-heritage-house: A guesthouse-style hotel in Arusha, suited to travellers who prefer a smaller, more personal place to rest before or after a safari or climb. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
grand-melia-arusha: A larger resort-style hotel in Arusha, with extensive grounds. A comfortable choice for a restful arrival or departure night, especially before or after a Kilimanjaro climb. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
seronera-public-campsite: A public campsite in the central Serengeti, near Seronera. Facilities are basic, with shared toilets and limited water, and wildlife can pass through at night. A good base for budget camping safaris. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
nyani-public-campsite: A public campsite in the Serengeti, used on camping safaris. It is basic, with shared facilities, and puts you close to the sights and sounds of the bush at night. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
tarangire-public-campsite: A public campsite inside Tarangire National Park, used on budget camping safaris. Facilities are simple, and elephants and other wildlife can pass close by at night. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
simba-b-campsite: A public campsite on the Ngorongoro Crater rim. It is cool and often windy, so bring a warm sleeping bag. The position allows an early descent into the crater. Rates, room types and facilities vary by season, so ask us for current details when you request a quote.
